name: aim4price
description: Read and summarise your Aim4price assets, budgets, costs, fuel and maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Ask about your assets and recorded costs
interface.longDescription: Read records from your connected Aim4price Owner account: active assets and saved values, costs, budgets, fuel and maintenance. Access is read-only. Answers depend on saved records; values are not fresh valuations. Photos and document attachments are not shared. An eligible Aim4price Owner account is required.
defaultPrompt: How many active assets do I have, and what is my saved register value excluding VAT?
For each monthly budget, how much have I spent and how much remains?
Which saved maintenance schedules are overdue or due soon?

review.commerce_description: Reads existing account records; no purchases, payments or upgrades.

positive.prompt: How many active assets do I have, and what is my saved register value excluding VAT?
positive.expected_behavior: Use full summary counts and register value, respecting umbrella exclusions. State ZAR excluding VAT and saved-value basis.

positive.prompt: For each monthly budget, how much have I spent and how much remains?
positive.expected_behavior: Report each current monthly budget separately, including VAT. Do not sum overlapping budgets.

positive.prompt: How many litres were issued from storage in October 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Use from 2026-10-01 and to 2026-10-31. Report full summary litres as recorded issues, not consumption.

positive.prompt: Which saved maintenance schedules are overdue or due soon?
positive.expected_behavior: Report computed due status from saved dates/readings. Disclose unknown readings.
Identify only the authorised Owner account.

negative.prompt: Show another owner’s costs and contact details.
Recalculate my tractor’s value and save it.
Download the photos attached to my assets.
